name: Sliced Volume Coordinate Mapping
definition: Converts 3D voxel coordinates into 2D texture coordinates for a volume stored as a tiled grid of 2D slices in a single image.
summary: Sliced Volume Coordinate Mapping converts 3D voxel coordinates into 2D texture coordinates by flattening volumetric data into a tiled 2D grid, enabling GPU sampling without 3D texture hardware support.
